phrase: an Orthopaedic Footwear and Insoles Brand
verdict: Yes. Colour Me Mad (CMM) from Mumbai pitched orthopaedic footwear and custom insoles on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Foot pain is common, and doctors recommend supportive footwear, but most orthopaedic shoes look dull.
angle: Diabetics, older people and those on their feet all day need supportive footwear. Custom insoles and stylish orthopaedic shoes serve them. Doctors and physiotherapists are influential.
